name: Accomplishment
overview: Scripture reveals that true accomplishment is rooted in righteousness and reliance on Christ's strength. The righteous bear fruit that leads to life and wisdom, exemplified by those who win souls (Proverbs 11:30). God’s plans for His people are purposeful and hopeful, promising an expected end of peace (Jeremiah 29:11). Jesus, as the light of the world, guides followers away from darkness into the light of life (John 8:12), empowering believers to overcome challenges. Through Christ’s strength, all things become possible (Philippians 4:13), enabling maturity and self-control (James 3:2), and ultimately bringing glory to the Lamb worthy of all honor and blessing (Revelation 5:12).
